pieces.title: Backfill default_model for profiles touched by preference migration
pieces.body: 41/96 generations in batch 8841 ran on the legacy fallback model because the profile default_model column was nulled by migration 341. Repro: select id from generation where batch_id = 8841 and model = 'flux-legacy'. Fix: backfill from preference history and add a regression test that a cleared default falls back to the org default instead of legacy.
